title: Custom Robotic Arm
description: Custom robotic arm developed through mechanical CAD, additive manufacturing, drivetrain iteration, 24 V stepper electronics, and a purpose-built 8:1 planetary shoulder actuator. Joint calibration and repeatable motion are the next milestones before camera-based manipulation.
imageAlt: Current physical prototype of Aakarsh Sangar's custom robotic arm with gripper and wiring

title: Jetson Orin Nano Robotics Platform
description: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano used for rPPG pipeline experimentation and planned as the embedded computer for future camera-based block detection after the robotic arm demonstrates calibrated, repeatable motion.
imageAlt: Jetson Orin Nano robotics platform setup

title: Faultline
description: CalHacks AI prototype that organized literature search, evidence extraction, conflict identification, and experiment suggestions into a visible research workflow with a preserved reasoning trail.

images.alt: Faultline typed message exchange and agent event dashboard

title: Vision-Based Health Monitoring System
description: Runnable computer-vision prototype for experimenting with pulse-related signal estimation from camera video on a Jetson Orin Nano; it is not presented as a clinically validated measurement system.

title: FIRST / FTC Robotics
description: Team competition robot for which I contributed subsystem CAD, mechanical packaging, build decisions, and selected sensor and control logic. Awards and match outcomes are team results.
imageAlt: FTC competition robot with team number 18263, mecanum drivetrain, transfer rollers, and integrated mechanisms
